name: 33154 · Surfside, FL
findings: ZIP 33154 (Surfside) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33154 (Surfside) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33154 (Surfside) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
